unit.why: An ethical teaching on restraint in eating and drinking and on care with permitted food. It cites sources and embeds one brief exemplum, R. Zvi of Zhidachov's remark about his mother's pregnancy, which is captured below as a minimal story.
unit.boundary_note: Opens the section 'מענין מאכלים' that begins at the end of the previous division; the teaching on eating continues into the next division.

stories.start_quote: ושמעתי שהה״צ רבינו צבי מזדיטשוב אמר על עצמו
stories.end_quote: זאת גרם לו שלא הגיע למעלה זו
stories.summary_en: R. Zvi of Zhidachov said of himself that he could have risen above the level of a seraph, but did not because his mother, while pregnant with him, craved and ate a little cold cabbage from a gentile's barrel.

tags.why: The anecdote is an exemplum inside a homiletic discourse on eating
